results.title: From erotic fantasy to Indian identity, a famous Italian calendar finds a new story
results.description: The 2027 edition of the Pirelli Calendar pays homage to India, showcasing a stunning lineup of local talent. Initiated by renowned Norwegian photographer Sølve Sundsbø alongside the late Raghu Rai, the project has been lovingly completed by his daughter Avani Rai. This iteration embraces outdoor settings, featuring both celebrated icons and skilled local artisans, reflecting a profound evolution from sensual imagery to the celebration of cultural identity and diverse narratives.

results.title: What Is Cookie Stuffing? Bill Gates’ Daughter Phoebe Gates’ Startup Phia Under Scrutiny
results.description: What is cookie stuffing? Bill Gates daughter Phoebe Gates’ shopping startup Phia is facing allegations that it used tracking features to claim credit for sales it did not generate. A Bloomberg investigation said the founders knew about the practice for months. Phia says the features were removed on July 7, transactions are being reviewed and misattributed commissions are being reversed.
